## Checklist

- [ ] Every commit is signed off (`git commit -s`).
- [ ] No sealed file changed, or the pull request says which, and the published chains are re-run or marked as run on the earlier seal.
- [ ] Every published `results.json` still aggregates to the same `RESULTS.md`.
- [ ] A new condition has its own `results/<group>/`, including `PROVENANCE.md`.
